data.description:
## The defect

`JiraDataCenterTransport` builds two whole-project maps with an UNPAGINATED search:

    def get_issuelinks_map(self, project_key):
        issues = self.search_issues(f"project = {project_key}")     # no paging
        ...
    def get_comment_map(self, project_key):
        issues = self.search_issues(f"project = {project_key}")     # no paging
        ...

`search_issues` on this transport is `(jql, start_at=0, max_results=50)`. Both calls take the DEFAULT,
so on any project with more than 50 issues both maps silently cover only the FIRST 50.

Consequences, both silent:
* **links** — issues beyond the first 50 appear to have NO links. The differ can then emit spurious
  link-creation mutations, and cannot detect removals on those issues at all.
* **comments** — comment sync is silently incomplete beyond the first 50 issues.

Neither raises. The pass converges and reports success.

## This is the SAME defect class I already fixed, and I fixed only one instance

`get_parent_map` had exactly this bug (advancing by the requested page size, breaking on a short
page). It was caught by OSS comparison and fixed in change 1105 with a regression test — measured at
20 of 250 parents recovered before the fix.

When I fixed it I patched THAT METHOD instead of sweeping every `search_issues` caller in the
transport. Two siblings were left behind. The lesson generalises beyond this ticket: on finding a
defect class, audit for siblings before closing, because the second instance is cheaper to find than
to debug in production.

## Remediation

Page both, driven by what the server ACTUALLY returns rather than the requested size — Jira DC
silently truncates `maxResults` above `jira.search.views.default.max`, so a short page is not proof of
exhaustion. Advance by `len(batch)`; stop only on an empty page. Mirror the corrected
`get_parent_map` loop.

Consider a shared paging helper so a fourth caller cannot reintroduce it — the structural test in
[rebar:bda8-370d-23ad-4e36] catches an UNDECLARED member, not an unpaginated one.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] both methods page to exhaustion, asserted by a test with a client capping pages BELOW the
      requested size — the shape that caught the `get_parent_map` bug (a stub serving 250 issues but
      capping at 20 recovered only 20)
- [ ] no `search_issues` caller in the DC transport relies on the default `max_results`, asserted
      structurally so a fourth instance cannot be added silently
- [ ] the truncation-safe loop is shared rather than copied a third time
data.title: get_issuelinks_map and get_comment_map are unpaginated: silent truncation at 50 issues
